name: prologue
about: The prologue (level TUT_Avernus_C) from the pod room to the transponder, by the shortest known way. Targets are points and the level's own placed objects.

steps.goal: Leave the pod room by the door to the west
Ride the lift up in the surgery room
steps.note: The brain on the table up there may be talked to; it is not needed

steps.goal: Walk west; Lae'zel's talk starts by itself and she joins
steps.note: In her talk the last answer of the first choice goes straight to her plan

steps.goal: Win the fight with the imps
steps.note: On each party member's turn: cast or attack as now.can lists, then do=end

steps.goal: Walk north to the first ladder
Open the dead thrall in the east chamber: it carries the rune
Use the console by the pod with the prisoner
steps.note: Then answer 1 three times and roll: the pod opens

steps.goal: Talk to the freed prisoner, Shadowheart; she joins
Walk south to the room before the helm
Enter the helm and run for the transponder at its far end
steps.note: A talk plays on the way and a fight begins

steps.goal: Use the transponder: the prologue ends
